segments.text: 注意力就是你所需要的一切

translations.text: 当前主流的序列转换模型基于复杂的循环神经网络或卷积神经网络，包含编码器和解码器。 性能最好的模型还通过注意力机制连接编码器和解码器。 我们提出了一种简单的新网络架构 Transformer，它完全基于注意力机制，彻底摒弃了循环结构和卷积。 在两项机器翻译任务上的实验表明，这些模型的翻译质量更高，并行能力更强，所需的训练时间也显著缩短。 我们的模型在 WMT 2014 英译德任务上达到 28.4 BLEU，比包括集成模型在内的已有最佳结果提高了 2 BLEU 以上。 在 WMT 2014 英译法任务上，我们的模型在 8 块 GPU 上训练 3.5 天后，取得了 41.8 BLEU 的单模型最佳成绩，训练成本仅为文献中最佳模型的一小部分。 我们还将 Transformer 成功应用于英语成分句法分析，在训练数据充足和有限的两种情况下均取得良好效果，表明它能很好地泛化到其他任务。
translations.source_text: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder. The best performing models also connect the encoder and decoder through an attention mechanism. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely. Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train. Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles, by over 2 BLEU. On the WMT 2014 English-to-French translation task, our model establishes a new single-model state-of-the-art BLEU score of 41.8 after training for 3.5 days on eight GPUs, a small fraction of the training costs of the best models from the literature. We show that the Transformer generalizes well to other tasks by applying it successfully to English constituency parsing both with large and limited training data.

source_segments.text: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder.
The best performing models also connect the encoder and decoder through an attention mechanism.
We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.
Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train.
Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles, by over 2 BLEU.

On the WMT 2014 English-to-French translation task, our model establishes a new single-model state-of-the-art BLEU score of 41.8 after training for 3.5 days on eight GPUs, a small fraction of the training costs of the best models from the literature.
We show that the Transformer generalizes well to other tasks by applying it successfully to English constituency parsing both with large and limited training data.

translations.text: 循环神经网络，尤其是长短期记忆网络 [13] 和门控循环神经网络 [7]，已成为语言建模、机器翻译等序列建模与序列转换问题中公认的先进方法 [35, 2, 5]。 此后，大量研究持续推进循环语言模型和编码器—解码器架构的性能边界 [38, 24, 15]。
translations.source_text: Recurrent neural networks, long short-term memory [13] and gated recurrent [7] neural networks in particular, have been firmly established as state of the art approaches in sequence modeling and transduction problems such as language modeling and machine translation [35, 2, 5]. Numerous efforts have since continued to push the boundaries of recurrent language models and encoder-decoder architectures [38, 24, 15].

source_segments.text: Recurrent neural networks, long short-term memory [13] and gated recurrent [7] neural networks in particular, have been firmly established as state of the art approaches in sequence modeling and transduction problems such as language modeling and machine translation [35, 2, 5].
Numerous efforts have since continued to push the boundaries of recurrent language models and encoder-decoder architectures [38, 24, 15].

segments.text: 循环神经网络，尤其是长短期记忆网络 [13] 和门控循环神经网络 [7]，已成为语言建模、机器翻译等序列建模与序列转换问题中公认的先进方法 [35, 2, 5]。
此后，大量研究持续推进循环语言模型和编码器—解码器架构的性能边界 [38, 24, 15]。

translations.text: 循环模型通常沿输入和输出序列中的符号位置分解计算。 它们将序列位置与计算时间步一一对应，根据前一隐藏状态 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__ 和位置 t 的输入，依次生成隐藏状态序列 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__。 这种固有的顺序性使单个训练样本内部无法并行计算；当序列较长时，由于内存限制了跨样本的批处理规模，这一问题尤为突出。 近期研究通过因式分解技巧 [21] 和条件计算 [32] 显著提高了计算效率，其中条件计算还改善了模型性能。 然而，顺序计算这一根本限制仍然存在。
translations.source_text: Recurrent models typically factor computation along the symbol positions of the input and output sequences. Aligning the positions to steps in computation time, they generate a sequence of hidden states __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ , as a function of the previous hidden state __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__ and the input for position t . This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths, as memory constraints limit batching across examples. Recent work has achieved significant improvements in computational efficiency through factorization tricks [21] and conditional computation [32], while also improving model performance in case of the latter. The fundamental constraint of sequential computation, however, remains.

translations.text: 注意力机制已成为多种任务中表现出色的序列建模与序列转换模型不可或缺的组成部分，能够对依赖关系建模，而不受相关位置在输入或输出序列中相距多远的限制 [2,19]。 然而，除少数情况 [27] 外，这些注意力机制通常都与循环网络结合使用。
translations.source_text: Attention mechanisms have become an integral part of compelling sequence modeling and transduction models in various tasks, allowing modeling of dependencies without regard to their distance in the input or output sequences [2,19]. In all but a few cases [27], however, such attention mechanisms are used in conjunction with a recurrent network.

source_segments.text: Attention mechanisms have become an integral part of compelling sequence modeling and transduction models in various tasks, allowing modeling of dependencies without regard to their distance in the input or output sequences [2,19].
In all but a few cases [27], however, such attention mechanisms are used in conjunction with a recurrent network.

然而，除少数情况 [27] 外，这些注意力机制通常都与循环网络结合使用。

translations.text: 在这项工作中，我们提出 Transformer：一种舍弃循环结构、完全依靠注意力机制来捕捉输入与输出之间全局依赖关系的模型架构。 Transformer 支持显著更高程度的并行计算，在 8 块 P100 GPU 上仅训练 12 小时，就能达到新的最佳翻译质量。
translations.source_text: In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output. The Transformer allows for significantly more parallelization and can reach a new state of the art in translation quality after being trained for as little as twelve hours on eight P100 GPUs.

source_segments.text: In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.
The Transformer allows for significantly more parallelization and can reach a new state of the art in translation quality after being trained for as little as twelve hours on eight P100 GPUs.

segments.text: 在这项工作中，我们提出 Transformer：一种舍弃循环结构、完全依靠注意力机制来捕捉输入与输出之间全局依赖关系的模型架构。
Transformer 支持显著更高程度的并行计算，在 8 块 P100 GPU 上仅训练 12 小时，就能达到新的最佳翻译质量。

translations.text: 减少顺序计算同样是 Extended Neural GPU [16]、ByteNet [18] 和 ConvS2S [9] 的设计基础；这些模型均以卷积神经网络为基本构件，并行计算所有输入和输出位置的隐藏表示。 在这些模型中，关联任意两个输入或输出位置的信号所需的操作数会随位置间距离增加：ConvS2S 呈线性增长，ByteNet 呈对数增长。 这使学习相距较远位置之间的依赖关系更加困难 [12]。 在 Transformer 中，所需操作数减少为常数，但代价是对各位置进行注意力加权平均会降低有效分辨率；我们通过第 3.2 节介绍的多头注意力来抵消这一影响。
translations.source_text: The goal of reducing sequential computation also forms the foundation of the Extended Neural GPU [16], ByteNet [18] and ConvS2S [9], all of which use convolutional neural networks as basic building block, computing hidden representations in parallel for all input and output positions. In these models, the number of operations required to relate signals from two arbitrary input or output positions grows in the distance between positions, linearly for ConvS2S and logarithmically for ByteNet. This makes it more difficult to learn dependencies between distant positions [12]. In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention as described in section 3.2.

source_segments.text: The goal of reducing sequential computation also forms the foundation of the Extended Neural GPU [16], ByteNet [18] and ConvS2S [9], all of which use convolutional neural networks as basic building block, computing hidden representations in parallel for all input and output positions.

In these models, the number of operations required to relate signals from two arbitrary input or output positions grows in the distance between positions, linearly for ConvS2S and logarithmically for ByteNet.
This makes it more difficult to learn dependencies between distant positions [12].

In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention as described in section 3.2.

在这些模型中，关联任意两个输入或输出位置的信号所需的操作数会随位置间距离增加：ConvS2S 呈线性增长，ByteNet 呈对数增长。
这使学习相距较远位置之间的依赖关系更加困难 [12]。
在 Transformer 中，所需操作数减少为常数，但代价是对各位置进行注意力加权平均会降低有效分辨率；我们通过第 3.2 节介绍的多头注意力来抵消这一影响。

translations.text: 自注意力有时也称为内部注意力，是一种通过关联单个序列中的不同位置来计算该序列表示的注意力机制。 自注意力已成功应用于阅读理解、抽象式摘要、文本蕴含以及学习与任务无关的句子表示等多种任务 [4, 27, 28, 22]。
translations.source_text: Self-attention, sometimes called intra-attention is an attention mechanism relating different positions of a single sequence in order to compute a representation of the sequence. Self-attention has been used successfully in a variety of tasks including reading comprehension, abstractive summarization, textual entailment and learning task-independent sentence representations [4, 27, 28, 22].

source_segments.text: Self-attention, sometimes called intra-attention is an attention mechanism relating different positions of a single sequence in order to compute a representation of the sequence.

Self-attention has been used successfully in a variety of tasks including reading comprehension, abstractive summarization, textual entailment and learning task-independent sentence representations [4, 27, 28, 22].

translations.source_text: End-to-end memory networks are based on a recurrent attention mechanism instead of sequencealigned recurrence and have been shown to perform well on simple-language question answering and language modeling tasks [34].

translations.text: 然而，据我们所知，Transformer 是第一个完全依赖自注意力计算输入和输出表示、无需使用沿序列位置展开的 RNN 或卷积的序列转换模型。 接下来，我们将介绍 Transformer，说明采用自注意力的动机，并讨论它相较于 [17, 18] 和 [9] 等模型的优势。
translations.source_text: To the best of our knowledge, however, the Transformer is the first transduction model relying entirely on self-attention to compute representations of its input and output without using sequencealigned RNNs or convolution. In the following sections, we will describe the Transformer, motivate self-attention and discuss its advantages over models such as [17, 18] and [9].

source_segments.text: To the best of our knowledge, however, the Transformer is the first transduction model relying entirely on self-attention to compute representations of its input and output without using sequencealigned RNNs or convolution.
In the following sections, we will describe the Transformer, motivate self-attention and discuss its advantages over models such as [17, 18] and [9].

segments.text: 然而，据我们所知，Transformer 是第一个完全依赖自注意力计算输入和输出表示、无需使用沿序列位置展开的 RNN 或卷积的序列转换模型。
接下来，我们将介绍 Transformer，说明采用自注意力的动机，并讨论它相较于 [17, 18] 和 [9] 等模型的优势。

translations.text: 大多数有竞争力的神经序列转换模型都采用编码器—解码器结构 [5, 2, 35]。 其中，编码器将输入的符号表示序列 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ 映射为连续表示序列 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__。 给定 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_2__，解码器随后逐个生成符号，得到输出序列 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_3__。 模型在每一步都采用自回归方式 [10]，将此前生成的符号作为额外输入，用于生成下一个符号。
translations.source_text: Most competitive neural sequence transduction models have an encoder-decoder structure [5, 2, 35]. Here, the encoder maps an input sequence of symbol representations __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ to a sequence of continuous representations __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__ . Given __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_2__ , the decoder then generates an output sequence __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_3__ of symbols one element at a time. At each step the model is auto-regressive [10], consuming the previously generated symbols as additional input when generating the next.

Here, the encoder maps an input sequence of symbol representations __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ to a sequence of continuous representations __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__ .
Given __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_2__ , the decoder then generates an output sequence __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_3__ of symbols one element at a time.
At each step the model is auto-regressive [10], consuming the previously generated symbols as additional input when generating the next.

segments.text: 大多数有竞争力的神经序列转换模型都采用编码器—解码器结构 [5, 2, 35]。
其中，编码器将输入的符号表示序列 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ 映射为连续表示序列 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__。
给定 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_2__，解码器随后逐个生成符号，得到输出序列 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_3__。
模型在每一步都采用自回归方式 [10]，将此前生成的符号作为额外输入，用于生成下一个符号。

translations.text: __MY_SCHOLAR_BOLD_START_0__编码器：__MY_SCHOLAR_BOLD_END_0__ 编码器由 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ 个相同的层堆叠而成。 每层包含两个子层。 第一个子层是多头自注意力机制，第二个子层是简单的逐位置全连接前馈网络。 我们在这两个子层的外围分别使用残差连接 [11]，然后进行层归一化 [1]。 也就是说，每个子层的输出为 LayerNorm(x + Sublayer(x))，其中 Sublayer(x) 是该子层自身实现的函数。 为便于使用这些残差连接，模型中的所有子层以及嵌入层的输出维度均为 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__
translations.source_text: __MY_SCHOLAR_BOLD_START_0__Encoder:__MY_SCHOLAR_BOLD_END_0__ The encoder is composed of a stack of __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ identical layers. Each layer has two sub-layers. The first is a multi-head self-attention mechanism, and the second is a simple, positionwise fully connected feed-forward network. We employ a residual connection [11] around each of the two sub-layers, followed by layer normalization [1]. That is, the output of each sub-layer is LayerNorm( x+ Sublayer(x)) , where Sublayer(x) is the function implemented by the sub-layer itself. To facilitate these residual connections, all sub-layers in the model, as well as the embedding layers, produce outputs of dimension __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__

我们在这两个子层的外围分别使用残差连接 [11]，然后进行层归一化 [1]。

translations.text: __MY_SCHOLAR_BOLD_START_0__解码器：__MY_SCHOLAR_BOLD_END_0__ 解码器同样由 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ 个相同的层堆叠而成。 除编码器每层包含的两个子层外，解码器还加入了第三个子层，对编码器堆栈的输出执行多头注意力。 与编码器类似，我们在每个子层外围使用残差连接，然后进行层归一化。 我们还修改了解码器堆栈中的自注意力子层，防止各位置关注其后的位置。 这种掩码机制与输出嵌入偏移一个位置的做法相结合，确保位置 i 的预测仅依赖于位置小于 i 的已知输出。
translations.source_text: __MY_SCHOLAR_BOLD_START_0__Decoder:__MY_SCHOLAR_BOLD_END_0__ The decoder is also composed of a stack of __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ identical layers. In addition to the two sub-layers in each encoder layer, the decoder inserts a third sub-layer, which performs multi-head attention over the output of the encoder stack. Similar to the encoder, we employ residual connections around each of the sub-layers, followed by layer normalization. We also modify the self-attention sub-layer in the decoder stack to prevent positions from attending to subsequent positions. This masking, combined with fact that the output embeddings are offset by one position, ensures that the predictions for position i can depend only on the known outputs at positions less than i.

translations.text: 最常用的两种注意力函数是加性注意力 [2] 和点积（乘性）注意力。 除缩放因子 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ 外，点积注意力与我们的算法相同。 加性注意力使用含单个隐藏层的前馈网络计算相容性函数。 虽然两者的理论复杂度相近，但点积注意力可以通过高度优化的矩阵乘法代码实现，因此在实际运行中速度更快，空间效率也更高。
translations.source_text: The two most commonly used attention functions are additive attention [2], and dot-product (multiplicative) attention. Dot-product attention is identical to our algorithm, except for the scaling factor of __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ . Additive attention computes the compatibility function using a feed-forward network with a single hidden layer. While the two are similar in theoretical complexity, dot-product attention is much faster and more space-efficient in practice, since it can be implemented using highly optimized matrix multiplication code.

translations.text: - 类似地，解码器中的自注意力层使每个位置都能关注解码器中截至该位置的所有位置，包括该位置本身。 为保持自回归特性，我们需要防止解码器中的信息向左流动。 我们在缩放点积注意力内部实现这一限制：将 softmax 输入中所有对应非法连接的值掩蔽掉，即将其设为 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__。 参见图 2。
translations.source_text: - Similarly, self-attention layers in the decoder allow each position in the decoder to attend to all positions in the decoder up to and including that position. We need to prevent leftward information flow in the decoder to preserve the auto-regressive property. We implement this inside of scaled dot-product attention by masking out (setting to __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ ) all values in the input of the softmax which correspond to illegal connections. See Figure 2.

source_segments.text: - Similarly, self-attention layers in the decoder allow each position in the decoder to attend to all positions in the decoder up to and including that position.
We need to prevent leftward information flow in the decoder to preserve the auto-regressive property.
We implement this inside of scaled dot-product attention by masking out (setting to __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ ) all values in the input of the softmax which correspond to illegal connections.
See Figure 2.

segments.text: - 类似地，解码器中的自注意力层使每个位置都能关注解码器中截至该位置的所有位置，包括该位置本身。
为保持自回归特性，我们需要防止解码器中的信息向左流动。
我们在缩放点积注意力内部实现这一限制：将 softmax 输入中所有对应非法连接的值掩蔽掉，即将其设为 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__。
参见图 2。

translations.text: 除注意力子层外，编码器和解码器的每一层还包含一个全连接前馈网络，以相同方式分别作用于每个位置。 该网络由两次线性变换组成，中间使用 ReLU 激活函数。
translations.source_text: In addition to attention sub-layers, each of the layers in our encoder and decoder contains a fully connected feed-forward network, which is applied to each position separately and identically. This consists of two linear transformations with a ReLU activation in between.

source_segments.text: In addition to attention sub-layers, each of the layers in our encoder and decoder contains a fully connected feed-forward network, which is applied to each position separately and identically.
This consists of two linear transformations with a ReLU activation in between.

segments.text: 除注意力子层外，编码器和解码器的每一层还包含一个全连接前馈网络，以相同方式分别作用于每个位置。
该网络由两次线性变换组成，中间使用 ReLU 激活函数。

translations.text: 虽然不同位置使用相同的线性变换，但不同层使用的参数各不相同。 也可以将其描述为两次卷积核大小为 1 的卷积。 输入和输出的维度为 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__，中间层的维度为 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__
translations.source_text: While the linear transformations are the same across different positions, they use different parameters from layer to layer. Another way of describing this is as two convolutions with kernel size 1. The dimensionality of input and output is __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ , and the inner-layer has dimensionality __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__

source_segments.text: While the linear transformations are the same across different positions, they use different parameters from layer to layer.
Another way of describing this is as two convolutions with kernel size 1.
The dimensionality of input and output is __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ , and the inner-layer has dimensionality __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__

segments.text: 虽然不同位置使用相同的线性变换，但不同层使用的参数各不相同。
也可以将其描述为两次卷积核大小为 1 的卷积。
输入和输出的维度为 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__，中间层的维度为 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__

translations.text: 与其他序列转换模型类似，我们使用可学习的嵌入，将输入词元和输出词元转换为维度为 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ 的向量。 我们还使用常规的可学习线性变换和 softmax 函数，将解码器的输出转换为对下一个词元的预测概率。 在我们的模型中，两个嵌入层和 softmax 前的线性变换共享同一个权重矩阵，与 [30] 类似。 在嵌入层中，我们将这些权重乘以 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__。
translations.source_text: Similarly to other sequence transduction models, we use learned embeddings to convert the input tokens and output tokens to vectors of dimension __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ . We also use the usual learned linear transformation and softmax function to convert the decoder output to predicted next-token probabilities. In our model, we share the same weight matrix between the two embedding layers and the pre-softmax linear transformation, similar to [30]. In the embedding layers, we multiply those weights by __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__ .

source_segments.text: Similarly to other sequence transduction models, we use learned embeddings to convert the input tokens and output tokens to vectors of dimension __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ .
We also use the usual learned linear transformation and softmax function to convert the decoder output to predicted next-token probabilities.
In our model, we share the same weight matrix between the two embedding layers and the pre-softmax linear transformation, similar to [30].
In the embedding layers, we multiply those weights by __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__ .

segments.text: 与其他序列转换模型类似，我们使用可学习的嵌入，将输入词元和输出词元转换为维度为 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_0__ 的向量。
我们还使用常规的可学习线性变换和 softmax 函数，将解码器的输出转换为对下一个词元的预测概率。
在我们的模型中，两个嵌入层和 softmax 前的线性变换共享同一个权重矩阵，与 [30] 类似。
在嵌入层中，我们将这些权重乘以 __MY_SCHOLAR_MATH_1__。

vocabulary.meaning: 注意力机制：根据查询与键的相关性，对值进行加权组合。

sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.quote: We call our particular attention "Scaled Dot-Product Attention" (Figure 2).

details.context_explanation: 本文的缩放点积注意力将查询与键的点积按维度缩放，经 softmax 得到权重，再对值进行加权组合。
